message: API server URL uses plaintext http, so credentials and tokens travel in the clear
fail:
openapi: 3.1.0
servers:
  - url: http://api.internal.example.com/v1
    description: internal
pass:
openapi: 3.1.0
servers:
  - url: https://api.internal.example.com/v1
    description: internal

message: Credentials are embedded in the API server URL (leaks via spec, logs and referrers)
fix: Remove the userinfo part and pass a token in the Authorization header

message: API key is passed in the query string, where it lands in logs, proxies and browser history
fix: Move the key to a header (in: header) or use an OAuth2 bearer scheme
fail:
components:
  securitySchemes:
    SessionKey:
      type: apiKey
      name: X-Session-Token
      in: query
pass:
components:
  securitySchemes:
    SessionKey:
      type: apiKey
      name: X-Session-Token
      in: header

message: HTTP Basic auth sends base64 (reversible) credentials on every request
fix: Use an OAuth2/OIDC bearer scheme, ideally with PKCE
fail:
components:
  securitySchemes:
    BasicAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: basic
pass:
components:
  securitySchemes:
    BearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer

message: OAuth2 resource-owner-password or implicit flow (deprecated in OAuth 2.1; no proof of possession)
fix: Use the authorization code flow with PKCE, or device code for input-constrained clients
fail:
components:
  securitySchemes:
    OAuth:
      type: oauth2
      flows:
        password:
          tokenUrl: https://auth.example.com/token
          scopes: {}
pass:
components:
  securitySchemes:
    OAuth:
      type: oauth2
      flows:
        authorizationCode:
          tokenUrl: https://auth.example.com/token
          authorizationUrl: https://auth.example.com/authorize
          scopes: {}

message: Schema $ref points at a remote http URL: fetched unverified and unencrypted, so a third party can rewrite your contract
fix: Vendor the schema locally, or reference it over https with a checksum in CI
pass:
components:
  schemas:
    User:
      $ref: '#/components/schemas/UserBase'
  parameters:
    - name: docs
      in: query
      example: http://example.com/help

message: Schema $ref resolves to another host, so the API contract depends on something you do not build
fix: Vendor the document, or pin it and verify it in CI
pass:
components:
  schemas:
    Money:
      $ref: '#/components/schemas/MoneyBase'
      description: see http://example.com/money for details

message: Debug or internal management surface is published in the API contract
fix: Remove the path from the published spec, or gate it behind auth and a separate host

message: Swagger 2.0 spec: superseded, and it cannot express the security features current tooling expects
fail:
swagger: "2.0"
info:
  title: Legacy orders API
  version: "1.0"
pass:
openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  title: Orders API
  version: "1.0"
